name: AligNeRF
definition: Improves training NeRF on high-resolution images by combining MLP with convolutional layers and proposing alignment-aware strategies for moving objects.
summary: AligNeRF is a NeRF training strategy that corrects misalignment artifacts and improves high-frequency detail by combining a convolution-augmented architecture with alignment-aware fine-tuning using patch-based sampling and optical flow.
